mapper.select: SELECT age_band AS name,COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN e.birth_date IS NULL THEN '年龄未知' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,e.birth_date,CURRENT_DATE) < 60 THEN '60岁以下' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,e.birth_date,CURRENT_DATE) < 70 THEN '60至69岁' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,e.birth_date,CURRENT_DATE) < 80 THEN '70至79岁' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,e.birth_date,CURRENT_DATE) < 90 THEN '80至89岁' ELSE '90岁及以上' END AS age_band FROM elder e ) grouped GROUP BY age_band ORDER BY age_band
SELECT CASE e.gender WHEN 'MALE' THEN '男' WHEN 'FEMALE' THEN '女' ELSE '未知' END AS name,COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM elder e GROUP BY e.gender ORDER BY e.gender
SELECT r.name AS name,COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM elder e JOIN region r ON r.id=e.region_id GROUP BY r.id,r.name ORDER BY r.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS measurements,COUNT(DISTINCT h.elder_id) AS people, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.abnormal=TRUE THEN h.elder_id END) AS abnormalPeople, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN h.abnormal=TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS abnormalRecords FROM health_record h JOIN elder e ON e.id=h.elder_id

SELECT CAST(h.measured_at AS DATE) AS name,COUNT(*) AS `value`, SUM(CASE WHEN h.abnormal=TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal FROM health_record h JOIN elder e ON e.id=h.elder_id GROUP BY CAST(h.measured_at AS DATE) ORDER BY CAST(h.measured_at AS DATE)
mapper.sql: COUNT(*) AS planned, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at < #{cutoff} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS completed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.due_at < #{cutoff} AND (r.completed_at IS NULL OR r.completed_at >= #{cutoff}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS overdue, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at < #{cutoff} AND r.completed_at > p.due_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS late
mapper.select: SELECT FROM followup_plan p JOIN elder e ON e.id=p.elder_id LEFT JOIN followup_record r ON r.plan_id=p.id
SELECT d.name AS name, FROM followup_plan p JOIN elder e ON e.id=p.elder_id JOIN doctor d ON d.id=p.doctor_id LEFT JOIN followup_record r ON r.plan_id=p.id GROUP BY d.id,d.name ORDER BY d.id
